dedupAudit.matchMethod: Artist plus title normalization; object accession/source identifiers when held. Comparisons against full 383, older 451 and 204 Class III date/source records; no exact artist/title or accession collisions found in inspected subsets. Not a global provenance certification.
dedupAudit.accepted856Gap: Full 856 archive not available in consulted branch registries as one fully enumerable accepted-source corpus; therefore do not assert eight genuinely new physical objects for the entire app.
dedupAudit.earlierKnownObjectExcluded: Stefan Lochner Simon-and-Jude panel already present in B03 institutional research crosswalk, not counted.
dedupAudit.partialSceneSemantics: Fabritius and Reni correspond to principal sacred events appropriate as contextual vigil artwork; do not label them exact vigil illustrations.

institutionalUsePolicy.rule: Städel explicitly provides downloadable images labelled Public Domain for any purpose; credit Städel Museum, Frankfurt am Main. Do not use unrelated copyrighted objects.
